technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot Test with @SpringBootTest for integration-style acceptance tests
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream TestSupport (MessageCollector, TestChannelBinder) for processor testing
Use Testcontainers for external dependencies (HDFS, Mail server) in sink acceptance tests
Implement tests using JUnit 5 with parameterized tests for multiple scenarios
Follow existing project test conventions and package structure
Use embedded Kafka/RabbitMQ for message broker integration where needed
Generate test reports in JUnit XML format for CI integration
Tag acceptance tests with @Tag("acceptance") for CI pipeline separation
assumptions: The modules (json-tuple, script, scripts, splitter, gauge, aggregate-counter, field-value-counter, hdfs-dataset, mail) are existing Spring Cloud Stream processor/sink implementations in the codebase
Project uses Maven or Gradle with standard Spring Boot test dependencies already configured
CI pipeline (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins) already exists and can run Maven/Gradle test phases
Testcontainers library is available or can be added for HDFS and Mail integration tests
Each module has a well-defined input/output contract (Message<?>, POJO, byte[]) documented or inferable from code
No new production code changes are required; only test code addition
Development environment has Java 17+, Docker for Testcontainers
Existing unit tests cover basic functionality; acceptance tests focus on end-to-end flow and integration points
Team has familiarity with Spring Cloud Stream testing patterns

activities.activity_description: Analyze json-tuple processor functionality, design acceptance test scenarios (valid JSON, invalid JSON, missing fields, nested objects), implement tests using Spring Cloud Stream TestSupport, verify JSON path extraction and tuple emission, integrate with CI

Analyze script processor (single script) functionality, design test scenarios (Groovy/JS/Python scripts, variable binding, error handling, script compilation caching), implement tests with various script types, verify output message transformation

Analyze scripts processor (multiple scripts chaining) functionality, design test scenarios (script chaining, inter-script variable passing, failure propagation, mixed language scripts), implement tests verifying pipeline execution order and data flow

Analyze splitter processor functionality, design test scenarios (collection splitting, array splitting, custom splitter expressions, empty payload handling, large payload performance), implement tests verifying each split message content and headers

Analyze gauge sink functionality (metric gauge reporting), design test scenarios (value updates, metric tags/labels, gauge reset, concurrent updates), implement tests using Micrometer Test MeterRegistry, verify metric registration and value reporting

Analyze aggregate-counter sink (time-windowed counter aggregation), design test scenarios (counter increments, window expiration, multiple keys, retention policy), implement tests with time manipulation (Clock), verify aggregated counts per window

Analyze field-value-counter sink (field value frequency counting), design test scenarios (field extraction from POJO/JSON, value counting, top-N reporting, TTL expiration), implement tests verifying field-based counting accuracy

Analyze hdfs-dataset sink (HDFS file writing with partitioning), set up Testcontainers HDFS (MiniDFSCluster or container), design test scenarios (file creation, partitioning by time/field, file rotation, compression, Kerberos auth simulation), implement tests verifying written file content and structure

Analyze mail sink (SMTP email sending), set up Testcontainers MailHog/GreenMail, design test scenarios (simple mail, attachments, templating, recipient lists, authentication, TLS), implement tests verifying email construction and delivery to test SMTP server

activities.activity_name: CI integration and test suite configuration
activities.activity_description: Configure acceptance test profile (separate from unit tests), add Maven/Gradle test suite or profile for acceptance tests, configure CI pipeline to run acceptance tests stage, verify test reports publishing, add test timeout and retry configuration for flaky integration tests

activities.activity_name: Test infrastructure setup and shared utilities
activities.activity_description: Create shared test base classes, test data builders, custom assertions, Testcontainers configuration rules, embedded broker configuration, common test utilities for message creation and verification
